# EIStarter-UM

The unmodified [EIStarter-UM 0.2.9 archive](https://github.com/Kyr4l/ei-universal-mod/releases/download/0.8.7/EIStarter-UM-0.2.9.zip),
published with Universal Mod 0.8.7.

SHA256: `5f190de3f59e1cb3604de9c127f1100d577b40cb0564b1cbae173c3a5638d2a9`.

The installer embeds the archive and verifies its checksum before extracting it. It installs the launcher only when
the chosen folder has no EIStarter-UM 0.2.9 or later, preserving existing settings and mods.
